# PBS (Public Broadcasting Service)

> PBS is a trusted public media platform offering free streaming access to documentaries, news analysis, dramas, and educational content across history, science, arts, and culture.

PBS provides comprehensive educational and entertainment programming including acclaimed series like FRONTLINE, MASTERPIECE, and PBS News Hour. The platform features content from renowned producers and historians including Ken Burns, Henry Louis Gates Jr., and Spike Lee, covering American history, world affairs, science, and the arts.

## Key Topics

- FRONTLINE
- PBS News Hour

## News & Documentary Programming

- [Trusted News, Groundbreaking Documentaries and Political Commentary](https://www.pbs.org/explore/news-and-public-affairs): PBS news hub featuring PBS News Hour, FRONTLINE investigative journalism, Washington Week, and current events coverage.
- [Explore Award-Winning Documentaries & Indie Films](https://www.pbs.org/explore/documentaries-and-indie-films): Comprehensive collection of award-winning documentaries and independent films including FRONTLINE, Ken Burns productions, and American Masters.
- [FRONTLINE | Remaking the Middle East: The U.S., Israel & Iran](https://www.pbs.org/video/remaking-the-middle-east-the-us-israel-iran): FRONTLINE documentary examining Israel-Iran conflict and U.S. Middle East foreign policy.

## History & Culture

- [History Documentaries | American & World History Shows](https://www.pbs.org/explore/history): PBS history documentaries covering American and world history, Civil Rights, and historical figures.
- [Professor Henry Louis Gates, Jr. | Documentaries & Series](https://www.pbs.org/explore/henry-louis-gates-jr): Henry Louis Gates Jr. documentaries including Finding Your Roots, The Black Church, and genealogy series.
- [America at 250](https://www.pbs.org/explore/pbs-america-at-250): America at 250 anniversary celebration featuring Ken Burns, U.S. history content, and historical artifacts.
- [Explore Culture and Travel Shows](https://www.pbs.org/explore/culture): PBS culture and travel programming featuring Henry Louis Gates Jr., Spike Lee series, and cultural exploration.

## Drama & Entertainment

- [Watch British Dramas, Romances, International Dramas & More](https://www.pbs.org/explore/drama): PBS drama content including MASTERPIECE series, Call the Midwife, and international dramas.
- [Watch Live Music, Theater, and Art History Shows & Documentaries](https://www.pbs.org/explore/arts): PBS arts and music content hub featuring live performances, documentaries, and artist biographies.

## Science, Nature & Lifestyle

- [Best Science & Nature Documentaries](https://www.pbs.org/explore/science-and-nature): PBS science and nature documentaries including PBS Space Time, Eons, and environmental topics.
- [Cooking, Culinary Celebration & Food History Shows](https://www.pbs.org/explore/food): PBS cooking and food shows including A Chef's Life, food history, and culinary content.
- [How-To, DIY & Shows About Improving Your Home](https://www.pbs.org/explore/home-and-how-to): PBS DIY and home improvement guides featuring Antiques Roadshow, gardening, crafts, and lifestyle content.

## Homepage & Navigation

- [PBS: Public Broadcasting Service](https://www.pbs.org): PBS homepage featuring full episodes, news analysis, documentaries on history, science, and art.

## Optional

- [Online Funder Support](https://pbs.org/online-sponsorship-support): PBS help center for online sponsorship, funder support, and advertising opportunities.
